title: Hub ARCHITECTURE.md past the ~400-line spill guideline
cluster_summary: Re-measured on the feature branches: all seven hubs are 422-578 lines. Only two mandated sections break the documentation-§3 ~60-line spill MUST: AuraMaster Module Map (94 lines, mostly drag/snap/detach data-flow narrative) and LootHistory Module map (78 lines, duplicating module-map.md). Both are cheap per-repo spills. The rest are SHOULD-level overshoots, which documentation.md:344 says to report by shape and not by arithmetic ('1071 lines, not 412'). Their only real defects are duplication and stale history: PFE's 1609-char re-vendor narrative, PM's census band dispositions copied from RESULTS.md, and retired-row narratives left in the MM/PM/PC registers. Recommendation: fix AM and LH, and trim MM and PFE together with their sibling items. Optionally add one sentence upstream in WowAddonStandards documentation-§3 saying that retiring a register row means deleting it and leaving its history in the cited bundle, and have the dev-copilot audit playbook stop filing hubs under ~450 lines when no section breaches the spill. That stops the MM/PM/PC regrowth.

verdicts.assessment: Measured: hub 426 lines, ## Module Map 94 lines (:44-137), and documentation.md:339 makes that a MUST spill. Most of it is a drag/snap/detach/tooltip behaviour narrative filed under the wrong section, so this is a real misplacement and not just a line count.
verdicts.remediation: Move the data-flow narrative (~:64-134) into docs/data-flow.md, plus any per-module rows into docs/module-map.md. Leave a short summary naming the engine-facing modules plus exactly one link. Confirm Module Map is <=~60 lines. The hub total then drops below ~400 as a side effect. Keep tests/test_docs.lua green.

verdicts.assessment: 464 lines, but no mandated section breaches the spill. The weight is in the non-mandated sections 'The stand-down' (74) and Launcher (61). Profiles (the suggested move) is already a summary plus one link to profiles.md. Moving text for the number alone would be churn.

Measured: hub 478 lines, ## Module map 78 lines with load-order bullets and a per-file table duplicating docs/module-map.md, which is a MUST-spill breach and a drift risk. Event subscriptions (63) and Documented deviations (65) have no named spill target, and the register is the single home, so they are out of scope.
verdicts.remediation: Move the per-file table and load-order bullets into docs/module-map.md (merging with what is already there), leaving a summary paragraph plus exactly one link. Leave Event subscriptions and Documented deviations as they are. Don't chase an exact 400.

verdicts.assessment: 578 lines is the largest overshoot, but the spill MUST is met. The weight is Documented deviations (123) and Documentation map (74). Five retired-row paragraphs (:413-458) are history, and two open with the misleading lead-in '**One row is ratified.**' over rows that were retired, so cheap deletion has some value.
verdicts.remediation: Batch with MM-A-24: reduce each retired-row paragraph to a one-line pointer to its frozen bundle and remove the misleading '**One row is ratified.**' lead-ins. Trim the conditional-row measurement prose in the Documentation map to counts. Run tests/test_doc_structure.lua afterwards.

verdicts.assessment: At 422 lines the hub is within the rule's stated tolerance ('not 412'), and no spill MUST is breached. The only real defect is duplication: the census sub-heading tells the PanelEditor/Artwork peel twice, and it records 1000-1500 band dispositions in prose while saying that band lives in automated-tests/RESULTS.md.
verdicts.remediation: Only if PanelMaster is touched anyway: drop the perf-decline preamble, and cut the census peel and band prose to the census statement plus a link to RESULTS.md. Keep the 'Files over the 1500-line cap' heading and table for the kit gate.

verdicts.assessment: Measured: 435 lines. Line 55 is a single 1609-char re-vendor narrative (v1.64.0..v1.68.1) duplicating docs/revendor/, and it has already gone stale (PFE-26a). The length is marginal. The value is in removing the drifting second copy. '## The disabled state is total' (79) is non-mandated and needs no move.
verdicts.remediation: Fold into the PFE-26a fix: cut the Overview re-vendor narrative to one sentence pointing at docs/revendor/. Do not move the disabled-state section.

verdicts.assessment: 434 lines is within tolerance, and no spill MUST is breached. The suggested target heading '## The cap exemption' does not exist in docs/global-strings.md (its headings are Nothing loads..., Files, The NS.GlobalStrings table, Regenerating chunks, Why split), and layout-§1 requires the census heading and table to stay under Documented deviations for test_layout_cap.
verdicts.remediation: If done: create a new '## The cap exemption' section in docs/global-strings.md and move only the three-condition and gate explanatory prose into it, keeping the 'Files over the 1500-line cap' heading, measurement command, table and verdict in ARCHITECTURE.md. Shorten the retired-row narratives to one line each with the PC-id/bundle. Run test_layout_cap.lua and test_doc_structure.lua.
